entities.text: Mahadeva vs The Special Land Acquisition Officer
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This appeal is filed by the appellants / land owners under Section 54(2) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 challenging the judgment and award dated 09.08.2016 passed by the V Additional District and Sessions Judge, Mysuru in L.A.C.A.No.105/2016 for further enhancement.
2.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge, Mysuru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The case of the claimants / appellants is that they are the owners of lands bearing Sy.Nos.94/1,
94/2, 92 and 92/1 of Rammanahalli Village, Kasaba Hobli, Mysuru Taluk.
The same was acquired by the respondent for the purpose of Varuna Nala under preliminary notification dated 21.07.1994.
The Land Acquisition Officer after enquiry, has fixed the market value of the said landa at the rate of Rs.50,000/- per acre and awarded the compensation of Rs.56,250/- per acre.
Being dissatisfied with the compensation awarded by the Land Acquisition Officer, the claimants filed an application under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act before the respondent.
On that application, the respondent sent reference to the III Additional Senior NC: 2023:KHC:29217 Civil Judge & C.J.M., Mysuru and numbered as LAC No.616/1998.

entities.text: III Additional Senior NC: 2023:KHC:29217 Civil Judge
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Thereafter, the Reference Court after full fledged trial, has fixed market value of the lands from Rs.50,000/- to Rs.70,000/- per acre by judgment and award dated 14.07.2005.
Being aggrieved by the same, for further enhancement, the claimants have filed an appeal before the V Additional District and Sessions Judge, Mysuru in L.A.C.A.No.105/2016.

entities.text: V Additional District and Sessions Judge, Mysuru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The First Appellate Court on reappreciation of oral and documentary evidence, has further enhanced the compensation from Rs.70,000/- to Rs.6,84,000/- per acre with all other consequential benefits.
Being aggrieved by the same, the claimants are before this Court in this appeal for further enhancement.

3. The learned counsel appearing for the claimants has contended that in respect of the similar lands acquired in the same village, for the very same purpose, by preliminary notification dated 10.08.1995, the LACA Court has awarded higher compensation i.e., Rs.8,84,000/- per acre.

The First Appellate Court without considering this NC: 2023:KHC:29217 aspect of the matter, has awarded only Rs.6,84,000/- per acre which shows that the First Appellate Court has discriminated in awarding the compensation and the same is in violation of the provisions of Article 14 of the Constitution of India.
Hence, he sought for enhancement of compensation.
4. Learned AGA appearing for the State has contended that the reliance sought by the claimants is in respect of L.A.C.A.No.39/2016 and it is related to the notification dated 10.08.1995.

The claimants'
property acquired by the respondent is one year prior to the notification dated 10.08.1995.
Therefore, First Appellate Court has rightly deducted 10% from the total award passed in L.A.C.A.No.39/2016 and rightly awarded the compensation of Rs.6,84,000/- per acre.
Hence, he sought for dismissal of the appeal.
5. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
Perused the judgment and award.

sentences.text:
It is not in dispute that the claimants / appellants are the owners of the lands bearing Sy.No.94/1,
94/2, 92 and 99/1 of Rammanahalli Village, Kasaba Hobli, Mysuru Taluk and the same were acquired by the respondent for the purpose of Varuna Nala under preliminary notification dated 21.07.1994.
The Land Acquisition Officer after enquiry, has fixed the market value of the said lands at the rate of Rs.50,000/- per acre and awarded the compensation of Rs.56,250/- per acre.
Being dissatisfied with the compensation awarded, the claimants filed an application under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act before the respondent.
On that application, the respondent sent reference to the III Additional Senior Civil Judge & C.J.M., Mysuru.

entities.text: III Additional Senior Civil Judge & C.J.M.,
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Thereafter, the Reference Court after full fledged trial, has fixed market value of the lands from Rs.50,000/- to Rs.70,000/- per acre by judgment and award dated 14.07.2005.
Being aggrieved by the same, for further enhancement, the claimants have filed an appeal before the V Additional District and Sessions Judge, Mysuru in L.A.C.A.No.105/2016.

entities.text: V Additional District and Sessions Judge, Mysuru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The First Appellate Court NC: 2023:KHC:29217 has further enhanced the compensation from Rs.70,000/- to Rs.6,84,000/- per acre with all other consequential benefits.

7. As contended by the learned counsel for the appellants, for the adjacent lands acquired by the respondent in the same village for the very same purpose under preliminary notification dated 10.08.1995, the First Appellate Court has awarded compensation of Rs.8,84,000/- per acre in L.A.C.A.No.39/2016.
8.
In the case on hand, the lands have been acquired by the respondent by notification dated 21.07.1994 which is almost one year prior to the notification dated 10.08.1995.

Considering that the lands in present case have been acquired one year prior to the lands acquired in LACA No.39/2016,
the First Appellate Court has rightly deducted 10% of the award of Rs.8,84,000/- per acre passed in L.A.C.A.No.39/2016.
Since the appellants sought NC: 2023:KHC:29217 Rs.6,84,000/- per acre only, the Appellate Court has restricted the award to Rs.6,84,000/-.
9. Learned counsel for the appellants submits that if 10% of the award of Rs.8,84,000/- passed in L.A.C.A.No.39/2016 is deducted and taken into consideration, it comes to Rs.7,96,400/-.
He further submits that the appellants are now seeking for amendment of relief sought by them and undertakes to deposit court fee before this Court and sought for enhancement.

10. Considering the same, if the appellants pay necessary Court fee, they are entitled for enhanced compensation of Rs.7,96,400/- per acre as against Rs.6,84,000/- awarded by the First Appellate Court with all other consequential benefits.
11. Accordingly, the appeal is allowed in part.
The order dated 09.08.2016 is hereby modified.
The market value of the lands acquired by the respondent is fixed at NC: 2023:KHC:29217
the rate of Rs.7,96,400/- per acre with all consequential benefit
